loudness.measure: lufs200Max: BS.1770 K-weighted loudness in a 200 ms window, maximised over every sample position with silence around the file. Loudness integrates over about the first 200 ms of a sound, so this window rates clicks and swells alike; the EBU momentary 400 ms window (lufsMomentaryMax, also given) under-reads very short sounds by about 3 dB more.
loudness.suggestedGain: suggestedGainDb = role target - lufs200Max, capped so the true peak after the gain stays at or under -6 dBTP (gainCapped); suggestedVolume = 10^(gain/20) for <Audio volume>

transition.use: whooshes and swells at cuts and reveals, usually in a gap between lines

meter.use: Rekt Meter needle and alarm rise: a feature moment, still under the voice

notify.use: ding, success, error, DEVELOPING pulse: clear but never startling

ui.use: pops, plops, ticks, swipes: often under narration

foley.use: keyboard, mouse, mug, chair, Badger's paws and tail: natural, background

loudness.narration: -14 LUFS-I (scripts/voice); beds about -26 LUFS-S, ducked 6 dB under speech (docs/AUDIO.md)

sync: Every syncMs and event time is a multiple of 1000/30 ms (1600 samples). Place a file at frame F - syncFrame30 to land its sync point on frame F. Impacts (syncKind 'transient') start their attack within 3 ms of the file start.
